title: Windows .exe and Linux .deb installers on every release
user_story: As a researcher I install PhD Research Lab with a normal installer (Windows .exe, Linux .deb) showing the PhD Lab logo; my research data lives outside the installation (any drive for projects) and survives uninstall/upgrade; every main release ships installers of its latest code.

requirements.description: An installed copy (installer marker) stores data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\PhDLab / $XDG_DATA_HOME/phdlab (~/.local/share/phdlab) / ~/Library/Application Support/PhDLab; PHDLAB_DATA_DIR always wins; a source checkout keeps data/.

Installers are built only from the qualified source/web archives (manifest SHA-256 verified), with pinned embedded Python 3.12.10 and hash-pinned runtime wheels, excluding development-only material, with the PhD Lab icon.

Every candidate (Development gate) and every main release builds both installers and proves install -> start -> /api/version -> uninstall with data kept; releases must contain exactly source, web, .exe and .deb with checksums.

nonfunctional: Per-user install without administrator rights on Windows
No network needed when installing the .deb
Unsigned until an owner certificate exists
acceptance_criteria: Installed copy never writes data into its folder

scenarios.expected: Installed copy uses the per-user data folder
Exact archives staged, marker written, dev material excluded
Mismatching embedded Python discarded; runtime lock only
Installers job (30 min bound) required by the Development gate

recovery: Releases stay draft until all four assets verify; revert packaging changes. TASK-INSTALLERS-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real staging/merge on temporary archives; real local installer build and smoke (docs/qa/evidence/installers-662/local-smoke.json); CI repeats on windows-latest and ubuntu-latest.

tdd.scope: RED: Development gate lacked installers (1 FAIL). GREEN: 12/12 PASS. Publish tests 10/10 (node).
